theorems.name: CAS12ConventionalRodrigues.standardLift_eq_rodrigues
theorems.domain: all n : Nat and x : Real
theorems.result: CAS12SignNormalization.standardLift n x = (Polynomial.derivative^[n] (((Polynomial.X : Polynomial Real)^2 - 1)^n)).eval x / ((2 : Real)^n * (n.factorial : Real))

theorems.name: CAS12ConventionalRodrigues.scalar_thomson_rodrigues_moment
theorems.result: 2 * Real.pi * integral_-1^1 [3 * (1 + mu^2) / (16 * Real.pi) * Rodrigues_n(mu)] = if n=0 then 1 else if n=2 then 1/10 else 0
